title: Impeaching Donald John Trump, President of the United States, for high crimes and misdemeanors.
short_title: Impeaching Donald John Trump, President of the United States, for high crimes and…
subjects: Government ethics and transparency, public corruption
latest_action: Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
summary: This resolution impeaches President Donald Trump for high crimes and misdemeanors. Specifically, the resolution sets forth one article of impeachment concerning abuse of presidential powers by allowing U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) to operate in violation of the First, Fourth, and Fifth Amendments to the U.S. Constitution while undermining judicial oversight.

fail.why: Set aside in the House by a vote to table it, 232–147
